WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost > 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_length) AS avg_per_rating_length,
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_per_rating_ratio
FROM per_rating;
